title: Alien bases as government-granted 'reservations'

tellings.quote: that um these are the places where our government or the governments of other countries have said you can have this spot to have your base. You stay away from us and we'll stay away from you.

plain: Alien bases on Earth may be something like reservations, places that the US and other governments have handed over on a deal of "you stay away from us and we'll stay away from you." A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan puts this idea to Michels as his own view. If it were so, governments would have quietly struck agreements with visitors and set land aside for them.
